lines.caption: This is a tour of pull request 119, for issue 118: Ctrl+Shift+A selects everything inside the current folder.
lines.say: This is a tour of pull request one nineteen, for issue one eighteen: control shift A selects everything inside the current folder.

lines.caption: It has three parts: what this PR adds, how it was built and verified, and what comes later.
Part 1. What this PR adds.
A new action, Select All in Folder, picks the folder from the cursor row and selects that folder's rows in one go.
You press Ctrl+Shift+A, or pick Select All in Folder from the Edit menu.
lines.say: You press control shift A, or pick Select All in Folder from the Edit menu.

lines.caption: If the cursor row is an expanded folder, that's the folder. Otherwise it's the row's parent folder.
The range runs from the folder's first child to the last visible row inside it.
One call selects the whole range, then any Loading rows are unselected. The cursor stays put.
With no folder to pick, such as a top-level file, it does the same Select All as Ctrl+A.
lines.say: With no folder to pick, such as a top-level file, it does the same Select All as control A.

lines.caption: And while a folder's files are still loading, it leaves the selection as it was.
Ctrl+A selects every row in the view, so selecting one opened folder's files took Shift+click or Shift+Down.
lines.say: Control A selects every row in the view, so selecting one opened folder's files took shift click or shift down.

lines.caption: The folder comes from the cursor, the row with the focus outline, not from the selection. The cursor never moves.
The key is a new row in Thunar's action table, so it can be changed in the shortcuts editor.
A file inside a folder, or a collapsed folder inside it, picks that folder.
A folder with thousands of rows is still one call, and the folder row itself isn't selected.
The icon and compact views, and Expandable Folders off, always get the plain Select All.
This table sums it up: an expanded folder, a row inside one, or a top-level row.
The icon and compact views and the loading case have no test of their own.
Ctrl+Shift+A used to be GTK's built-in unselect all key. Escape still unselects everything.
lines.say: Control shift A used to be G T K's built-in unselect all key. Escape still unselects everything.

lines.caption: The PR changes four source files, adds one test script, and adds this page and its narration.
To undo it, revert this PR. It adds no setting.
Part 2. How it was built and verified.
The test checks each case from the issue's table, on the same files the issue lists.
It compares the select everything cases with Ctrl+A, and reads the selection by copying and pasting it.
lines.say: It compares the select everything cases with control A, and reads the selection by copying and pasting it.

lines.caption: In a cloud container, the first commit built, and the smoke test and 18 other tests passed.
lines.say: In a cloud container, the first commit built, and the smoke test and eighteen other tests passed.

lines.caption: The new test failed at first, because a click left the cursor on the wrong row. The test was fixed.
Re-run, it passed every check: inside a folder, on a folder, the Edit menu, and the Select All cases.
The final review fixes were only compiled; they weren't built and tested here.
The loading case, the icon and compact views, and rebinding the key were not tested.
CI builds and tests the final code on this PR, and its screenshots get audited there.
A fresh review agent found 7 problems before the first push; 4 are fixed and 3 are left for the owner.
lines.say: A fresh review agent found seven problems before the first push; four are fixed and three are left for the owner.

lines.caption: A folder still loading no longer clears the selection, and two pieces of code were made simpler.
The fourth was this page itself: without it, CI's explainer job would have failed.
Three are left for the owner: the replaced GTK key, Loading rows under Ctrl+A, and the menu item in every view.
lines.say: Three are left for the owner: the replaced G T K key, Loading rows under control A, and the menu item in every view.

lines.caption: CI reviews every code push too, and reports in this PR's code review comment.
Real folders on the owner's desktop, and speed in a huge folder, are only seen after the merge.
The PR, its changes, CI's screenshots and the issue are all linked here.
Part 3. What comes later.
No open issue depends on this one. Issue 117 will just run this PR's test along with the rest.
And the owner can decide whether to open an issue that keeps Loading rows out of every Select All.
In short: Ctrl+Shift+A now selects just the folder you're in.
lines.say: In short: control shift A now selects just the folder you're in.
